WITH e AS (SELECT timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:03:36.815119+00' t),
att AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders, e WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND action='buy' AND created_at>=e.t),
fl AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.market_ticker FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id, e WHERE o.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND o.action='buy' AND o.created_at>=e.t),
sim AS (SELECT market_ticker, pnl, assumed_price, resolved_value,
        CASE WHEN market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl) THEN 'A_filled'
             WHEN market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM att) THEN 'B_ordered_nofill'
             ELSE 'C_never_ordered' END bucket
        FROM paper_trades, e WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND closed_at>=e.t)
SELECT bucket k,
       'n='||lpad(count(*)::text,3)
       ||' simPnL='||lpad(to_char(sum(pnl),'FM990.00'),6)
       ||' perTrade='||lpad(to_char(avg(pnl)*100,'FM990.00'),6)||'c'
       ||' entry='||lpad(to_char(COALESCE(avg(assumed_price),0),'FM990.0'),5)
       ||' winrate='||lpad(to_char(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN pnl>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(*),'FM990.0'),5)||'%'
       ||' losses='||lpad(sum(CASE WHEN pnl<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::text,3)
       ||' worst='||lpad(to_char(min(pnl),'FM990.00'),6) v
FROM sim GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'D_live_real_'||CASE WHEN s.realized_pnl>0 THEN 'wins' WHEN s.realized_pnl<0 THEN 'losses' ELSE 'flat' END,
       'n='||count(*)::text||' total='||to_char(sum(s.realized_pnl),'FM990.00')||' avg='||to_char(avg(s.realized_pnl)*100,'FM990.00')||'c worst='||to_char(min(s.realized_pnl),'FM990.00')
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, COALESCE(quantity_fp,quantity::numeric) qty, realized_pnl FROM positions WHERE market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) s
WHERE s.qty=0 AND s.realized_pnl IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
